product.schneider-t486dx33.summary: The 33 MHz 486DX tower positioned below the 50 MHz model.
product.schneider-t486dx33.history: The December 1992 German price list offered this machine for DM 3,069 net without a hard disk. It included MS-DOS 5.0 and Windows 3.1.
product.schneider-t486dx33.technical.opt: The list also offered 211 MB and 340 MB hard-disk configurations for DM 3,946 and DM 4,210 net, respectively.
product.schneider-t486dx33.technical.slo: The slots accommodate expansion cards. The sales sheet lists 7 16-bit slots and two floppy drives, 1.44 MB and 1.2 MB.
product.schneider-t486dx33.technical.ver: The offer is documented. A dedicated model and boot validation in BluMach remain pending.
product.schneider-t486dx33.technical.lim: The board still needs identification, an attributed BIOS needs preservation and an image with clear publication rights remains pending.
product.schneider-t486dx33.technical.pri: CC SELLER / BC, Schneider Computer, 12/1992, pp. 1–3
